title: The Afternoon Brief: Ipswich adds Fulham experience with Lukic signing
dek: Ipswich Town completed the acquisition of Serbian midfielder Sasa Lukic from Fulham on a four-year deal, marking the club's second signing from the same source in the summer window.
author: GoCheckMySports
key_fact: Ipswich is targeting players with established Premier League minutes, Lukic logged 26 appearances for Fulham last season, as it builds roster depth ahead of the new campaign.
bottom_line: Ipswich Town completed its second signing from Fulham this window, securing Serbian midfielder Sasa Lukic on a four-year deal. The 29-year-old brings 26 Premier League appearances from last season and gives the club added midfield depth as the transfer period continues. Watch for further moves from Fulham and how Lukic integrates into Ipswich's setup before the window closes.
body: Ipswich Town have signed Serbian midfielder Sasa Lukic from Fulham, bringing in a 29-year-old with immediate Premier League experience. Lukic, who made 26 league appearances for Fulham last season and 106 matches across all competitions, has committed to a four-year contract through 2030 on an undisclosed fee.

The move represents Ipswich's second acquisition from Fulham in the summer transfer window, suggesting a deliberate recruitment strategy built around proven players available from a single source. Lukic's arrival targets midfield depth at a position the club views as central to its tactical setup during what the desk reported is a competitive summer transfer period.

The reporting does not establish the specific tactical role Lukic will fill or timelines for his integration into Ipswich's squad. What remains to be tested is whether the Fulham connection continues to yield further moves before the window closes and how quickly Lukic settles into his new environment.
